items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after a meal is linked to a smaller rise in sugar, with the biggest difference seen in walks of 10 to 19 minutes. You walked after 2 of your scored meals, which is too few to see how it affects you yet.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Eating dinner at 8 pm or later is linked to a bigger rise in sugar, with dinners from 8-9 pm having a particularly big effect. Try to start dinner before 8 pm to see if it makes a difference for you.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: You averaged 13 hours of overnight fasting, which is a good start, and half of your nights reached 13 hours of fasting. Adding an overnight fast to your routine might make a small difference, but more research is needed to know for sure.
